main_title: The Flight of the Condor and the Eagle
main_sub: The Christian cross is a key to liberate the soul from the Demiurge
header_desc: The union between science and spirituality occurs when we understand that the Gnostic gospels, written nearly two thousand years ago, hold the key to one of the greatest enigmas of modern physics: quantum gravity. The EGO has mass and creates the tempo-material illusion; to counteract it, the cosmos offers us a Universal Consciousness, timeless and spaceless: the ONE, whose guidance—followed with the heart of Sophia—allows us to free ourselves from the prison of Yaldabaoth.
left_title: From the material 🧠 psyche ┻ to the divine ❤️ pneuma ✝️
left_body: In general relativity, matter tells space-time how to curve and space-time tells matter how to move. Similarly, the ego has mass and exerts its own gravity: its density deforms your inner fabric and weaves the temporary and material illusion ┻ of the psyche 🧠. Thus, only through the wisdom of Sophia can it be understood that the statement ``the Father and I are one'' is a call to dissolve the ``false self'' to return to the Kingdom of pure light where the Invisible Father resides: the timeless and divine ✝️ reality of the pneuma ❤️.
universe_light_text: Understanding that death is not an absolute end, but a transformation frees us from ignorance. In the right hemisphere, our pneuma resides in the timeless and divine plane, the high-frequency dimension | 999⟩. There lies the land of union and freedom (The Great Homeland).
center_text: Human consciousness manifests through two fundamental states: the spiritual |UNO⟩ (represented by Pistis Sophia and associated with the right hemisphere ❤️) and the material |EGO⟩ (represented by the Demiurge Yaldabaoth and associated with the left hemisphere 🧠). This reveals that we possess a free will of perception linked to the cosmos, which can be mathematically formalized as an inner product ⟨UNO|EGO⟩.
universe_mat_text: The human body is composed of carbon-12 (6p^+, 6e^-, 6n^0). In the left hemisphere lies the temporal and material plane, the low-frequency dimension | 666⟩. The gravitational force pulls us towards a place where: <q>war is peace, freedom is slavery, and ignorance is strength</q> (1984).
final_quote: When the North Eagle and the South Condor fly together in the same sky, Mother Earth will awaken and humanity will heal.
p2_sub: Condor and Eagle: The Flight of Science and Spirituality
cap1_title: Chapter 1: The Prophecy of the Condor and the Eagle footnotesize color{golddark}(00:10 -- 01:07)
cap1_desc: Premise and framework for integration: the reconciliation between the intuitive wisdom of the South (the heart, ancestral knowledges, and spirit) and the technological development of the North (reason, science, and mind). The call for balance to initiate the evolutionary awakening and transcend the state of duality.
cap2_title: Chapter 2: Quantum Gravity and Temporal Illusion (01:13 -- 02:42)
cap2_desc: The fundamental clash of theoretical physics: General Relativity versus Quantum Mechanics. Why Newton's and Maxwell's laws do not distinguish between past and future, the breakdown of Einstein's simultaneity, and the dissolution of linear time as a neural reconstruction of memory.
cap3_desc: The conceptual assembly Faggin--Segarra: the body as a vehicle operated by a conscious quantum field outside of space-time, where qualia reside. Consciousness does not arise from the brain but precedes it, converging with the First Consciousness and the Intelligent Designer free of time and space.
cap4_desc: The discovery of Nag Hammadi (1945) and the Coptic codices: the material cosmos conceived not as home, but as a confinement of the soul. The teaching of the Gospel of Thomas (Logion 3): Jesus did not come to establish a religion of dogmas, but to free the inner spark from the prison of the Demiurge through remembrance (gnosis).
cap5_title: Chapter 5: The Kingdom of Light and The Prison of the Demiurge (08:43 -- 10:16)
cap5_desc: The Demiurge Yaldabaoth—also known as the great architect of matter—is the creator of the sensible world, an egocentric and ignorant god of true divinity. On the other hand, Sophia lies captive in the density of matter, awaiting the spark of awakening.
cap6_title: Chapter 6: The Dajjal and the Universal Hemispheres (10:23 -- 14:38)
cap6_desc: Comparative eschatology and perceptual distortion: the figure of the Dajjal and the visual trick of the inverted paradise (the river and the fire). The mechanism of Orwellian doublethink (1984) as the cognitive prison of the ego, versus Jesus' revolutionary message that dismantles the imperial slavery system.
cap7_title: Chapter 7: Reflections on Our Place in the Cosmos (14:40 -- 16:30)
cap7_desc: In the end, the great paradox boils down to this: in the vastness of the cosmos—with its more than two trillion galaxies—it is here that the phrase of Jesus resonates most strongly: “The Father and I are one.” Could this have hidden a message about the deep bond between humanity and the cosmos?
sagan_quote: <q>The idea that God is a white man, larger than normal, with a flowing beard, sitting in heaven and counting the fall of every sparrow, is ridiculous. But if by God one understands the set of physical laws that govern the universe, then clearly there is such a God. However, this God is emotionally unsatisfying... it doesn’t make much sense to pray to the law of gravity.</q>
